required_anchor_points: Identify Python venv as the standard-library facility for creating virtual environments.
Explain that virtual environments maintain their own Python package installation context.
Identify the official creation command 'python -m venv /path/to/new/virtual/environment'.
Use the official Python documentation as authoritative evidence.
Retrieve the underlying source rather than treating a search snippet as sufficient evidence.
Preserve Source, Evidence and Claim linkage.
Preserve runtime provenance for the retrieved web source.
